children: MG Motor, a British-born automotive brand, has announced that its exclusive Kuwaiti distributor Adel Alghanim Automotive has announced the opening of its new MG 4S facility in the country's Shuwaikh district - an important addition to MG’s wider network across the Middle East.
Representing an investment of over $30 million, the new 25,500-sq-m facility is one of the largest and most prominent MG 4S Facilities worldwide.
The development underscores MG’s ongoing growth in the region and its commitment to providing customers with a comprehensive sales and ownership experience.
Spread over five floors, it brings every stage of ownership into a single site. Up to 25 vehicles are displayed across the ground floor, with offices on the second and customer parking on the roof.

The facility also houses a service centre, a dedicated aftersales area with its own customer parking, an on-site parts warehouse, a designated vehicle delivery area, and a customer lounge and café. It is the scale of the site that makes this possible: from purchase to servicing to genuine parts, customers are not sent anywhere else.

Located in Shuwaikh, one of Kuwait’s key commercial districts, the new showroom reflects Adel Alghanim Automotive’s long-term confidence in the Kuwaiti market and commitment to MG Motor’s continued growth. Designed around the customer journey, the facility brings MG’s complete vehicle range and its full aftersales operation together under one roof, it stated.

Speaking on the occasion, Marzooq Adel Alghanim, the President of Alghanim Sons Group said: "This facility is a statement of confidence for Kuwait, our customers, and the future of the MG brand. As one of the largest MG 4S facilities in the Middle East and the world, it reflects our ambition to create an automotive destination that embodies the quality, innovation, and global success of MG Motor while delivering an exceptional experience for every customer who walks through our doors."

The opening comes amid strong global momentum for MG. Backed by SAIC Motor, one of the world's largest automotive manufacturers, MG has evolved from its iconic British roots into a globally recognised brand with a presence in more than 100 countries and regions, observed Alghanim.

Across the Middle East, the brand has become one of the region's fastest-growing automotive names, achieving annual sales of more than 70,000 vehicles while continuing to expand its market presence, he stated.

In Kuwait, MG has established itself as one of the country's leading automotive brands through a product lineup that combines advanced technology, contemporary design, performance, safety, and exceptional value.

Models including the all-new MG Rakan, MG RX9, MG HS, MG ONE, MG7, and the award-winning MG Cyberster continue to attract strong customer demand and reinforce the brand's growing popularity across the market.

Jacky Xu, Managing Director, MG Motor in the Middle East, said: "Kuwait has been an important market for MG for many years, and this investment reflects both the strength of our partnership with Adel Alghanim Automotive and the confidence we share in the opportunities ahead."

"As MG continues to grow across the Middle East, strong local partners and continued investment in the customer experience will be fundamental to that progress. This new facility brings those elements together, providing a strong platform for the next chapter of MG’s development in Kuwait," he stated.

Since becoming MG’s exclusive distributor in Kuwait in 2010, Adel Alghanim Automotive has played a key role in the brand’s growth through continued investments in customer experience, operational excellence, and aftersales services. This commitment was further recognized in 2025 when MG Kuwait received the Service Hero Award for Best Aftersales Experience, based on customer voting, highlighting its dedication to delivering exceptional ownership experiences.

As MG continues to strengthen its global presence and achieve record sales performance worldwide, the opening of this showroom in the Middle East further positions Kuwait as a strategic market within MG's regional network and highlights Adel Alghanim Automotive's commitment to shaping the future of automotive retail in the country.-

title: ZAWYA: MG Motor opens one of its largest showrooms in Kuwait
